name: Chevening Scholarships
text: Fully funded one year master's awards for future leaders. Apply through the official portal before the deadline. Selection involves essays, references and an interview.

name: National Scholarship Portal schemes
text: Central and state scholarship schemes for students. Register on the official portal; applying is free.

name: Bright Futures First-Generation Award
text: Annual award for first-generation college students. Submit your transcript and a short essay through our website. Winners are announced in June.

name: World Merit Excellence Award
text: This scholarship supports high achieving undergraduate students who demonstrate leadership, community service and financial need. Recipients are selected by an independent committee based on academic record, a personal statement and two letters of recommendation. Submit a refundable deposit to secure your place.

name: Chevening Scholarship Portal
text: Apply now for a fully funded master's award. A registration fee is required to confirm your seat. Send your passport number to begin.

name: Global Youth Excellence Grant
text: Congratulations! You have been selected for a $5,000 grant. Pay a small processing fee by gift card to release your funds. Only 5 slots left!
